principles_catalog.name: Ação Direta e Pose a Pose

sequences.title: Corte curto de katana — amostra diagnóstica
sequences.motion_contract: Body-driven short descending diagonal cut. Rear-leg load, hips and shoulder coil; pressure transfers to flexed front knee, torso inclines, both hands accelerate a rigid katana; overshoot settles below execution; recover along controlled arc to original guard. Feet remain planted; no scene/root translation.

principles_applied.observed_result: Static R01 versus R03/R04 knee/torso change reviewed; no elastic steel. Continuous weight/force pending.
